_: The companion conversation's lines (methodology 11, O-19 B-lite + C + D). ALL DRAFT: written 2026-09-23 for the owner's review, like the stranger drafts. SUBTITLES ONLY: every companion speaks in a voice type of their own (Piper, Preston, Cait ...), none of which the six core renders cover, and the owner picks every voice by ear (V-9) - so none of these is rendered, and scripts/stage-voice.py counts them as subtitle-only by design. Greetings are persona-neutral because a greeting is chosen before any script has run. The answers are per persona and per verdict: a companion's answer is decided by their own state and their desire (O-22, B-lite), never by which register the player picked - so each answer set stands behind every proposition on the wheel. ASCII only (the plugin's zstring refuses anything else). Rewritten after microscope wave 3 (2026-09-23): a refusal is said for four different reasons and a 'not now' for two, so each line has to be true for all of them; and a yes promises no walk anywhere, since the follow (methodology 6) is not built.

wheel._: The player's four options. Three propositions, the stage-3 wording; the neutral slot (the offer's) holds the costless 'Later.' - 'Name your price for the night' is not a thing to say to someone who travels with you, and registers decide nothing here.

charm.prompt: Come away with me tonight. Just us.
charm.spoken: Come away with me tonight. Just us.

lines.text: Hey. Got a minute? Not for the road.
Can we stop a while? Just the two of us.
That look again. What's on your mind?
You're staring. Something you want to say?
Later, then. I'll hold you to it.
Sure. It'll keep.
Now that's a deal I'll take.
Not tonight. Give it a few more days on the road with me.
No. That's not a deal I'm making.
Here? With an audience? Find us somewhere private.
Not now. Later, when the work's done.
I was hoping you'd ask.
Not tonight. Stay close to me a while longer first.
No. Not like this.
Not in front of everyone. Somewhere that's only ours.
Not now. Later, when it's just the two of us.
Finally. I thought you'd never ask.
Not tonight. Wind me up a little more first.
No. Not happening.
Not with all these eyes on us. Get me somewhere private.
Hold that thought. Later, and I'll make it worth the wait.
Yes. Please.
Not yet. I need more time with you first.
No. I... no.
Not here. People are watching.
Not now. Later, maybe. When it's quiet.
